name: Fundamentals of Ev Charger Design
description: Electrical terminologies in EV charging, basics of voltage and current source systems and their operation, DC/DC converters in EV chargers, isolation in DC/DC topologies, basics of UPF rectifier operation, charger circuits for low power and high-power systems, control of EV chargers, CC-CV operation, charger system realization, EV interaction basics, grid interaction basics.
